parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES from compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor CHEMBL5162. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter assays for organism Homo sapiens. Sort by compound_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
